SLOT.title: SLOT references in dual_base_radix_vs_base
SLOT.snippet:
In shadcn v4 (2025-2026), the ecosystem has evolved into a **Dual-Base Architecture**. Developers can choose between two headless primitive libraries as the foundation for their components while maintaining the same Tailwind-styled visual layer and `data-slot` identity system.
While the underlying primitives handle composition differently (Radix uses the `asChild` pattern, Base UI often uses render props), these implementation details are abstracted away by the **`data-slot` attribute**.
**Finding:** A `dialog` component has the same `data-slot="dialog"` structure and roles whether it is installed with `--base radix` or `--base base`. This makes the Bridge system base-agnostic for visual reconstruction.

metadata.title: Figma Bridge: Spec-Driven Design System Automation
metadata.summary: A comprehensive system for bridging AI agents, Design Data Layers (DDL), and Figma. It automates Figma node creation and design token binding via a deterministic Plugin API. Key features include multi-mode variable sync (Phase 0), recursive node generation with Auto Layout (Phase A), and programmatic binding (Phase B). v4.0 (March 2026) pivots to an 'Instantiation-First' architecture, enforcing two design rules: Rule 1 (Nodes must load from root components like Pro Blocks) and Rule 2 (Values must bind to existing variables). Implementation highlights include a 4-phase Component Library Scanner (Discover, Sets, Standalone, Aliases) and a 'Verify-Only' main flow. Critically optimized for high-volume files (14K+ components) using page-level scanning, async yields, and a parallel 'prefetch-and-reuse' variable fetch pattern that reduces heavy Figma API round-trips by 80%.

metadata.title: BA to Design Input Pipeline System
metadata.summary: End-to-end architecture for the BA design input pipeline. Covers the 7-phase fractal 2-pipe design: Dual-layer gap discovery (BP-031), DDL-driven enrichment (Phase 3), consumer-backward validation (Phase 4), and a proposed 8-dimension self-learning loop (Phase 4++). Includes high-fidelity case studies (xPOS, 25 screens) and specific implementation patterns for VNPAY-branded onboarding flows (SCR-001..SCR-003). Captures reusable logic for phone auto-formatting, 6-cell secure OTP input with paste/auto-tabbing, and robust, automation-ready multi-screen navigation systems (BP-017 / BP-022 / BP-015).

metadata.title: shadcn Identity & Distillery: Component Anatomy and Extraction
metadata.summary: A comprehensive system for reverse-engineering, understanding, and distilling the shadcn/ui design system identity for AI-native automation. It features a CLI-first extraction strategy using a 5-phase pipeline to capture a complete offline superset of data. Key components include the 309-slot mandatory data-slot protocol and deterministic identity mapping. This KI provides the data foundation (distillery) used by the automated shadcn-to-Bridge Spec converter (Phase 3.2) in the Figma Bridge system.

metadata.title: Design Data Layer (DDL): Unified Token and Intelligence System
metadata.summary: The central source of truth for design tokens, UX context, and structural design system rules in the VNPAY Agentic Framework. It implements a 4-tier hierarchical resolution model (TailwindCSS → Theme → Mode → Custom) using a SQLite-backed (~2.8MB) W3C DTCG-compliant database. The system manages 1,100+ tokens and provides critical services for AI agents, including recursive alias resolution, WCAG AA contrast auditing, and component schema validation (BP-013). It acts as the foundational data layer for both automated screen generation and the Figma Bridge plugin ecosystem.

metadata.title: VNPAY Agentic Context and Skill Architecture (Context Sync)
metadata.summary: A specialized system for harvesting, classifying, and synthesizing context across multiple agent sessions and knowledge items. It implements the '/sync' skill architecture, enabling agents to reconcile fragmented session data into a unified Overview and a forward-looking Roadmap. This KI also documents the 'Skill Creator' pattern, a 4-phase development model (Intent, Harvester, Template-based Synthesis, and User Review) for building robust, deterministic agentic skills with high precision. The system results in high-fidelity context preservation through a branch-detection classification algorithm based on 9 domain keywords.
